svg.text: Relative ground levels · existing building positions retained · campus gameplay layout
Main hall, library and Pilot School.
Connected by S2 stairs and R1 ramp.
Low retaining walls frame the paths.
Dorm, dining and all mech facilities.
S1 and S2 each change level by 2 m.
S3 descends 1 m into the rain garden.
Each changes 2 m over a 40 m run.
Alternate routes beside the stair paths.
Pond water +1 m; rain garden -1 m.
Levels are relative to the entry datum.
Retaining walls, stairs and ramps make the campus levels readable in game.
Stairs change routes; full building footprints and flat mech access remain intact.
